package.name: kdl_typekit
package.description: ROS 2 port of the Orocos kdl_typekit (orocos/rtt_geometry): an RTT typekit that registers the KDL C++ geometric and kinematic types (Frame, Rotation, Twist, Wrench, Vector, JntArray, Chain, Tree, Jacobian, Joint, Segment) with the Orocos type system so they can be used as operation and port types. CORBA transport is omitted (CORBA is disabled in this build).
